title: Leading bands at Birdland
summary: Brew Moore, Coleman Hawkins, Wardell Gray and Teddy Edwards as sidemen.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What kinds of were yo working with when you were a leader at Birdland? What kind of personnel did you have? Do you remember?

Yeah, we worked... Well sometimes I had Brew Moore, and sometimes Coleman Hawkins. If Hawk didn't have me, I'd just say I worked with him, because he worked for me a couple of times. Not too many different type of... I would use Wardell and Teddy Edwards if they were here.

Being that they weren't here, I can't say I could use them all the time, right? Especially Teddy. Him being way out there, I can't afford to pay him to come here and lay around and do nothing, do nothing strenuously... But he has been here...
Yeah, he's been here. In fact, he was here this past summer. He was in Europe, too, you know, and he came here... I think he worked with Sweets here at the Blue Note.
